BIGWORDS.PAGE: Turn any screen into a sign BIGWORDS PAGE Editor Docs Displays and the editor need JavaScript. The docs explain how the URLs work. Big words for any screen Make a full-screen sign, timer or message from a link. Hold up your phone at arrivals, put a countdown on the TV, or show the Wi-Fi password at the front desk. No account, no app, nothing stored on a server. The link is the whole display, so you can share it or bookmark it. Open the editor Read the docs View fullscreen https://bigwords.page/#Say%20it%20**big.**||Any%20screen.%0AAny%20size.||No%20app.%20No%20login.%0AJust%20a%20**URL.**&amp;bg=111111&amp;fg=ffd60a&amp;font=4&amp;interval=3 Make one by hand Using the built-in editor is easiest, but generate a link however you like. Type a message after the #. https://bigwords.page/#Hello World Add settings with &amp;key=value. https://bigwords.page/#Hello World&amp;bg=000000&amp;fg=ffd60a&amp;font=4 %0A starts a new line. # makes a heading (write it as %23). https://bigwords.page/#%23 Room 204%0AMeeting in progress || splits the message into slides. https://bigwords.page/#Coffee ☕||Tea 🍵||Water 💧&amp;interval=2 Use cases Every card is a working link. Open it fullscreen, or load it into the editor and make it yours. Any device Works in any browser: phones, tablets, laptops, smart TVs. Markdown **bold**, *italic*, # and ## headings, real line breaks. Slides Split with || and they rotate on a timer. Countdowns Put {countdown} anywhere and set &amp;until= for a date or &amp;timer= for a length of time. QR codes &amp; images Links, Wi-Fi, calls, texts and email, generated in your browser. No third-party services. Private by design The message lives in the URL fragment, which browsers never send to a server. BIGWORDS.PAGE is open source under the MIT license. Fonts are bundled under their own open licenses. Docs · Editor · GitHub
